questions.question: On this day in 1877, which American inventor formally announced his creation of the phonograph, a machine capable of recording and playing back sound?
questions.explanation: Thomas Edison revealed his groundbreaking sound recording invention, the phonograph, on 21 November 1877.
questions.context:
On this day in 1877: Thomas Edison announced his invention of the phonograph, a device able to record and play sound.
Thomas Edison (American inventor and businessman (1847–1931)): Thomas Alva Edison was an American inventor and businessman known for his work on the incandescent light bulb, the phonograph, electric power distribution and early motion pictures.

questions.question: Which English actor is featured alongside an ensemble cast including Matt Damon and Tom Holland in Christopher Nolan's 2026 epic adaptation of 'The Odyssey'?
questions.explanation: Robert Pattinson stars in Christopher Nolan's 2026 film adaptation of Homer's ancient epic poem.
questions.context: The Odyssey (2026 film) (Film by Christopher Nolan): The Odyssey is a 2026 epic action fantasy film written and directed by Christopher Nolan, who produced it with his wife Emma Thomas. An adaptation of Homer's ancient Greek epic poem the Odyssey, it stars an ensemble cast including Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Lupita Nyong'o, Samantha Morton, Zendaya, and Charlize Theron.

questions.question: The 2017 song 'XXX' by rapper Kendrick Lamar features a guest performance from which legendary Irish rock band?
questions.explanation: 'XXX' features vocals and songwriting contributions from members of the rock group U2.
questions.context: XXX (Kendrick Lamar song) (2017 song by Kendrick Lamar featuring U2): "XXX" is a song by American rapper Kendrick Lamar, from his fourth studio album Damn, released on April 14, 2017. The eleventh track on the album, the song was written by Lamar, Mike Will Made It, DJ Dahi, Mark Spears a.k.a. Sounwave, Anthony Tiffith, Bono, the Edge, Adam Clayton, and Larry Mullen Jr., and produced by Mike Will Made It, DJ Dahi, and Sounwave, with additional production by Top Dawg and Bēkon.

questions.question: Which video game development company, founded in Scotland by David Jones and Mike Dailly, was originally known as DMA Design?
questions.explanation: Rockstar North was originally founded as DMA Design in Scotland before being rebranded under its current name.
questions.context: Grand Theft Auto (Video game series): Grand Theft Auto (GTA) is an action-adventure video game series created by the Scottish programmers David Jones and Mike Dailly at DMA Design, now known as Rockstar North. Later titles were developed under the oversight of brothers Dan and Sam Houser, Leslie Benzies and Aaron Garbut. It is primarily developed by Rockstar North and published by its American parent company, Rockstar Games. The name of the series is a term for motor vehicle theft in the United States.

questions.question: In the 2025 British crime drama series 'MobLand', which actor portrays the central character Harry Da Souza?
questions.explanation: Tom Hardy heads the cast of Paramount+'s 'MobLand' in the lead role of Harry Da Souza.
questions.context: MobLand (2025 British crime drama television series): MobLand is a crime drama television series created by Ronan Bennett for Paramount+. The series stars Tom Hardy as Harry Da Souza, Pierce Brosnan as Conrad Harrigan and Helen Mirren as Maeve Harrigan. Additional main characters include Kevin Harrigan, Jan Da Souza, Isabella Harrigan, Eddie Harrigan, and Seraphina Harrigan. Guy Ritchie, Anthony Byrne, Daniel Syrkin, and Lawrence Gough serve as directors. Jez Butterworth and Bennett are credited with writing all ten episodes of the first season.
